title: Farmer Scala compiler compile request

project.description: Absolute directory containing raw flat .scala source windows.

output.description: Absolute private generated-build directory; keep stable across edits to reuse the compiler JVM.

$comment: UTF-8 newline-delimited JSON on stdin/stdout. Successful replies include id,ok:true,artifact,sourceMap,hash,diagnostics:[],elapsedMs,cached. Failed replies have ok:false,artifact:null and diagnostics with file,line,column,endLine,endColumn,message (editor positions are one-based). Child sbt output is private; it never shares the protocol stream. The parent owns service cancellation/process lifetime.
